paragraphs.text: translated by
1. WHAT wish of Sarama hath brought her hither? The path leads far away to distant places.
paragraphs.original: किमिच्छन्ती सरमा प्रेदमानड्दूरे ह्यध्वा जगुरिः पराचैः ।
paragraphs.translit: kimicchantī saramā predamānaḍdūre hyadhvā jaguriḥ parācaiḥ |

paragraphs.text: What charge hast thou for us? Where turns thy journey? How hast thou made thy way o'er Rasa's waters.
paragraphs.original: कास्मेहितिः का परितक्म्यासीत्कथं रसाया अतरः पयांसि
paragraphs.translit: kāsmehitiḥ kā paritakmyāsītkathaṃ rasāyā ataraḥ payāṃsi

paragraphs.text: 2. I come appointed messenger of Indra, seeking your ample stores of wealth, O Panis.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रस्य दूतीरिषिता चरामि मह इच्छन्ती पणयो निधीन्वः ।
paragraphs.translit: indrasya dūtīriṣitā carāmi maha icchantī paṇayo nidhīnvaḥ |

paragraphs.text: This hath preserved me from the fear of crossing: thus have I made my way o'er Rasa's waters.
paragraphs.original: अतिष्कदो भियसा तन्न आवत्तथा रसाया अतरं पयांसि
paragraphs.translit: atiṣkado bhiyasā tanna āvattathā rasāyā ataraṃ payāṃsi

paragraphs.text: 3. What is that Indra like, what is his aspect whose envoy, Sarama, from afar thou comest?
paragraphs.original: कीदृङ्ङिन्द्रः सरमे का दृशीका यस्येदं दूतीरसरः पराकात् ।
paragraphs.translit: kīdṛṅṅindraḥ sarame kā dṛśīkā yasyedaṃ dūtīrasaraḥ parākāt |

paragraphs.text: Let him approach, and we will show him friendship: he shall be made the herdsman of our cattle.
paragraphs.original: आ च गच्छान्मित्रमेना दधामाथा गवां गोपतिर्नो भवाति
paragraphs.translit: ā ca gacchānmitramenā dadhāmāthā gavāṃ gopatirno bhavāti

paragraphs.text: 4. I know him safe from harm: but he can punish who sent me hither from afar as envoy.
paragraphs.original: नाहं तं वेद दभ्यं दभत्स यस्येदं दूतीरसरं पराकात् ।
paragraphs.translit: nāhaṃ taṃ veda dabhyaṃ dabhatsa yasyedaṃ dūtīrasaraṃ parākāt |

paragraphs.text: Him rivers flowing with deep waters bide not. Low will ye be, O Panis, slain by Indra.
paragraphs.original: न तं गूहन्ति स्रवतो गभीरा हता इन्द्रेण पणयः शयध्वे
paragraphs.translit: na taṃ gūhanti sravato gabhīrā hatā indreṇa paṇayaḥ śayadhve

paragraphs.text: 5. These are the kine which, Sarama, thou seekest, flying, O Blest One, to the ends of heaven.
paragraphs.original: इमा गावः सरमे या ऐच्छः परि दिवो अन्तान्सुभगे पतन्ती ।
paragraphs.translit: imā gāvaḥ sarame yā aicchaḥ pari divo antānsubhage patantī |

paragraphs.text: Who will loose these for thee without a battle? Yea, and sharp-pointed are our warlike weapons.
paragraphs.original: कस्त एना अव सृजादयुध्व्युतास्माकमायुधा सन्ति तिग्मा
paragraphs.translit: kasta enā ava sṛjādayudhvyutāsmākamāyudhā santi tigmā

paragraphs.text: 6. Even if your wicked bodies, O ye Panis, were arrow-proof, your words are weak for wounding;
paragraphs.original: असेन्या वः पणयो वचांस्यनिषव्यास्तन्वः सन्तु पापीः ।
paragraphs.translit: asenyā vaḥ paṇayo vacāṃsyaniṣavyāstanvaḥ santu pāpīḥ |

paragraphs.text: And were the path to you as yet unmastered, Brhaspati in neither case will spare you.
paragraphs.original: अधृष्टो व एतवा अस्तु पन्था बृहस्पतिर्व उभया न मृळात्
paragraphs.translit: adhṛṣṭo va etavā astu panthā bṛhaspatirva ubhayā na mṛḷāt

paragraphs.text: 7. Paved with the rock is this our treasure-chamber; filled full of precious things, of kine, and horses.
paragraphs.original: अयं निधिः सरमे अद्रिबुध्नो गोभिरश्वेभिर्वसुभिर्न्यृष्टः ।
paragraphs.translit: ayaṃ nidhiḥ sarame adribudhno gobhiraśvebhirvasubhirnyṛṣṭaḥ |

paragraphs.text: These Panis who are watchful keepers guard it. In vain hast thou approached this lonely station.
paragraphs.original: रक्षन्ति तं पणयो ये सुगोपा रेकु पदमलकमा जगन्थ
paragraphs.translit: rakṣanti taṃ paṇayo ye sugopā reku padamalakamā jagantha

paragraphs.text: 8. Rsis will come inspirited with Soma, Angirases unwearied, and Navagvas.
paragraphs.original: एह गमन्नृषयः सोमशिता अयास्यो अङ्गिरसो नवग्वाः ।
paragraphs.translit: eha gamannṛṣayaḥ somaśitā ayāsyo aṅgiraso navagvāḥ |

paragraphs.text: This stall of cattle will they part among them: then will the Panis wish these words unspoken.
paragraphs.original: त एतमूर्वं वि भजन्त गोनामथैतद्वचः पणयो वमन्नित्
paragraphs.translit: ta etamūrvaṃ vi bhajanta gonāmathaitadvacaḥ paṇayo vamannit

paragraphs.text: 9. Even thus, O Sarama, hast thou come hither, forced by celestial might to make the journey.
paragraphs.original: एवा च त्वं सरम आजगन्थ प्रबाधिता सहसा दैव्येन ।
paragraphs.translit: evā ca tvaṃ sarama ājagantha prabādhitā sahasā daivyena |

paragraphs.text: Turn thee not back, for thou shalt be our sister: O Blest One, we will give thee of the cattle.
paragraphs.original: स्वसारं त्वा कृणवै मा पुनर्गा अप ते गवां सुभगे भजाम
paragraphs.translit: svasāraṃ tvā kṛṇavai mā punargā apa te gavāṃ subhage bhajāma

paragraphs.text: 10. Brotherhood, sisterhood, I know not either: the dread Angirases and Indra know them.
paragraphs.original: नाहं वेद भ्रातृत्वं नो स्वसृत्वमिन्द्रो विदुरङ्गिरसश्च घोराः ।
paragraphs.translit: nāhaṃ veda bhrātṛtvaṃ no svasṛtvamindro viduraṅgirasaśca ghorāḥ |

paragraphs.text: They seemed to long for kine when I departed. Hence, into distance, be ye gone, O Panis.
paragraphs.original: गोकामा मे अच्छदयन्यदायमपात इत पणयो वरीयः
paragraphs.translit: gokāmā me acchadayanyadāyamapāta ita paṇayo varīyaḥ

paragraphs.text: 11. Hence, far away, ye Panis! Let the cattle lowing come forth as holy Law commandeth,
paragraphs.original: दूरमित पणयो वरीय उद्गावो यन्तु मिनतीरृतेन ।
paragraphs.translit: dūramita paṇayo varīya udgāvo yantu minatīrṛtena |

paragraphs.text: Kine which Brhaspati, and Soma, Rsis, sages, and pressing-stones have found when hidden.
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिर्या अविन्दन्निगूळ्हाः सोमो ग्रावाण ऋषयश्च विप्राः
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatiryā avindannigūḷhāḥ somo grāvāṇa ṛṣayaśca viprāḥ
